title: Gabi ng Aswang
short_description: Survive one night in a haunted barrio as the aswang hunts.
description: A fictional placeholder game. Lock your doors, ration your salt and garlic, and outlast a long night in a remote provincial barrio while something wicked stalks the rooftops.

title: Tumbang Preso Turbo
short_description: The classic street game, now with power-ups and chaos.
description: A fictional placeholder game. Knock the can, dodge the taya, and race your friends in fast-paced local multiplayer rounds set in a sunny neighborhood street.

title: Biyaheng Jeepney
short_description: Drive your jeepney route, pick up pasahero, and beat the traffic.
description: A fictional placeholder game. Customize your jeepney, call out the stops, and keep your passengers happy while navigating a bustling city route from dawn to dusk.

title: Sigaw ng Katipunan
short_description: Plan the uprising in a turn-based strategy set in the 1890s.
description: A fictional placeholder game. Recruit allies, manage secret meetings, and coordinate supply lines in a turn-based strategy inspired by the revolutionary era.

title: Tindahan Tycoon
short_description: Grow your sari-sari store from a tiny window to a neighborhood hub.
description: A fictional placeholder game. Stock the shelves, sell tingi-tingi, extend utang to loyal suki, and keep the resident duwende happy with offerings as your sari-sari store grows.

title: Diwata ng Bundok
short_description: Befriend the diwata and restore balance to a mythic mountain.
description: A fictional placeholder game. Explore an enchanted mountain, bargain with spirits, and grow in power as you uncover why the diwata have gone silent.
